text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas, Trainer-kun.
A present from Santa. May fortune be with you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just for today, though.
You remember that party a while back, right?
I had a conversation with Oguri-san back then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I hear your friends prepared your outfit.
It's as heartwarming as my fans are... truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even so, wearing this outfit for just today
feels like a waste. I wish we could
make more use of it, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Then it's simple. Next time, Hayahide
should be the star. As Santa.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And so, I volunteered to play Santa
at the academy's Christmas event.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still, when it comes to actually doing it, I feel a bit uneasy.
I wonder if everyone will truly be happy with me playing Santa...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah!!
Hayahide Santa spotted~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That outfit really stands out around the academy, to be honest.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. But you make a flawless Santa.
Thanks to you both. If there is any concern—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide explained to the two of them
that she was worried whether playing Santa would truly liven up the event.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Then let's hype it up with pure impact!!
For example—ah! Hayahide, turn around!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I knew it!! From behind, it looks way more
like a bearded Santa!! Let's deliver presents
at full throttle like this!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: B-Bushy beard?! My hair is... what?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that looks totally like Santa!!
I dub it: "Back-Pedaling Santaaa"--!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You mean the back is a face? Isn't that scary?
...Besides, if you're the star, just hand it over normally.
choice_data_list: Win with impact! It's all about the rear view!
Let's just hand it over normally, like a proper star would.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A-A bushy beard... from behind... hmm.
Still, it certainly has plenty of impact――all right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"—Hah!! Haaah!!
MERRY CHRISTMASSSSS!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? What was that just now...!?
A backwards Santa...ic!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
――Hah!! Taaah!!
HAPPY HOLIDAAAAYS!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaah!? What is with that suspicious figure!?
Could there be a suspicious person on campus...ッ!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-senpai!! Did you see it too?!
A weird Santa blasting backwards at crazy speed!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a suspicious person! How thrilling!
...I mean, wait, that's not right! This is a major crisis for the academy!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, it's time to show 'em what a hero can do!
I'm definitely gonna take 'em down! Hehehe!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Kgh...! What incredible fire in her eyes!!
I cannot let her catch up to me no matter what...!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Because right now, I am Santa! If my identity
is revealed, their dreams will be shattered...!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Damn it, I lost them!! And here was my chance to show off my hero powers~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Haa, haa... Alright! Somehow, I managed to fulfill my duties as Santa!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide went on to hand out many more presents, and soon enough, students had gathered all around her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The lead, is it...? Hmm.
In that case, I must carry myself with dignity.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas! Now then,
where are the good children who want presents—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Pick me, pick meee!! I want a happy,
marvelous present~~~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waah~ Maya wants a present too♪
Give me something mature, pleeease☆

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I get a present!? Yay!
Then Turbo wants all of it! Everything in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, that's not fair~!
Give me all of it too!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, one for each of you. I can't give you
a present unless you're good, you know?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh, so if I'm a good girl,
I'll get a present?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Then could there be... one for me too?!
I believe I've been a good girl, though—!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Miss Oguri...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This was a bit unexpected, but—fufu,
of course there is one for you too. Here, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Wonder what's inside?
I hope it's something edible!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide went on to hand out many more presents, and soon enough, students had gathered all around her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, there are plenty more presents.
—There is no need to rush, everyone."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I'm late. I've prepared something for you two as well.
Complete with a special letter.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's this, what's this...
"There are no end to the words of gratitude I have for you two.
First, on that day we first met—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Too long. I'll read it once I'm back at the dorm.
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I hope today proves to be a special day for the two of you.
—Merry Christmas.
